senses.gloss: m.hedge-hog, believed to suck and injure the udders of cattle.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 11:30">Targ. O. Lev. XI, 30</cite> <cite ref="J00366"><he>יַלָא</he></cite> ed. Berl. (Var. <cite ref="J00366"><he>יַלָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="J00366"><he>יָלָא</he></cite>; Y. <he>מינקת חויא</he>; h. text <cite ref="N00031"><he>אנקה</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>יָילֵי</he> &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 54b:19">Sabb. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>כי</he> … <he>לימצוה יי׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>יָאלֵי</he>) to prevent hedge-hogs from sucking them.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 4a:1">B. Bath. 4ᵃ</cite> top Herod put around Baba’s head <he>כלילא דיי׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>דיא׳</he>, v. Rabb. S. a. l. note) a garland made of skins of hedge-hogs which pricked his eyes out.
